citation: Bradley et al. 2015. Visualization and quantitation of GLUT4 translocation in human skeletal muscle following glucose ingestion and exercise. Physiological Reports 3:e12375.
protocol: 75 g glucose as 25% solution after overnight fast; blood at baseline, 30, 60, 120 min (experiment 2)
population: 10 healthy lean recreationally active participants per experiment; age 21-25, BMI about 23
note: Values are in running text only, a few minutes each, and mixed with biopsy findings; check the two experiments separately (exercise experiment 1 is not an OGTT). Units mmol/L and uIU/mL.
